purpose: Published-tariff estimates and conservative budget reservations, not invoices
service_policy: Standard/default, global routing, native token API only; no Batch, Flex, Fast/Priority, tools, regional/residency uplift, subscription credits, negotiated discounts or taxes in the base rates
usage_category_policy: Input, cached-input and cache-write token categories are mutually exclusive. When input_total includes cached/write tokens, subtract those subsets before base-input billing. Output uses the provider total; nested reasoning/thought counters are not added again.
unknown_usage_policy: Unknown usage, routing, account plan or billed extras must stay unknown, not zero. Reserve a conservative upper bound before a call; reconcile actual usage afterward.

gpt-6.1-sol.rate_basis: First-party Responses API, Standard/default, <=272000 input tokens
gpt-6.1-sol.cache_write_policy: Default 30-minute write rate; write tokens are a disjoint input category, not an additive charge on the same base input tokens.

gpt-6-astra.rate_basis: First-party Responses API, Standard/default, <=272000 input tokens
gpt-6-astra.cache_write_policy: Default 30-minute write rate; write tokens are a disjoint input category, not an additive charge on the same base input tokens.

claude-opus-5-5.rate_basis: First-party Messages API, Standard/global; default cache write rate is 5 minutes
claude-opus-5-5.long_context: Listed rates cover the common 128000-token cohort cap; do not borrow older Opus long-context pricing.

claude-fable-5-1.rate_basis: First-party Messages API, Standard/global; default cache write rate is 5 minutes
claude-fable-5-1.long_context: Listed rates cover the common 128000-token cohort cap.

deepseek-v4-pro.rate_basis: Conservative peak tariff for budget reservation; actual request cost must select peak/off_peak by UTC timestamp

schedule.holiday_calendar_status: Not embedded; on weekday holidays use a verified calendar or retain conservative peak estimate.

deepseek-v4-pro.cache_write_policy: No separately billed write category is listed. If a normalizer emits a disjoint creation-token category, price it at the cache-miss input rate; do not also bill those tokens as uncached input.

gemini-4-argon.rate_basis: Conservative gross estimate: Standard/global tariff before conditional 50-percent promotional credits
gemini-4-argon.gross_rate_derivation: The current Standard/global table displays 2.00/0.10/10.00 and states promotion is 50-percent credits back; gross rates are derived by reversing that credit and equal the published December 1 regular tariff.
gemini-4-argon.cache_write_policy: Only implicit/durable caching is supported. No distinct write-token SKU is listed; a disjoint creation-token category aliases the uncached-input rate.
gemini-4-argon.reasoning_output_policy: Output rate covers both response and reasoning tokens. Do not double-count thoughts when provider total output already includes them.

future_failed_long_decode_billing.description: Retrievable completion usage above 32K can be charged even when a request fails due to a client/server timeout. Preserve usage from partial/failed calls; unknown usage is not zero.

glm-5.3.rate_basis: Z.ai general prepaid API tariff, USD; not Coding Plan subscription allocation
glm-5.3.coding_plan_policy: A Coding Plan subscription is not a zero-cost API rate. Record its actual subscription allocation/quota policy separately; do not label general prepaid tariff as an actual Coding Plan bill.
glm-5.3.cache_write_policy: No distinct write-token rate is listed. A disjoint creation-token category aliases the input rate; cached storage is currently described as limited-time free, not a guaranteed permanent rate.
